tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search the Wandura ad-template catalog. Use this first to find a template to clone. Returns aspect and duration so you can tell the user what shape the ad will be.

q.description: Free text over title, subtitle, product, hook, setting

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one template by id. The generation prompt is intentionally not returned — send an intent to clone_template instead.

tools.name: preview_generation
tools.description: Price a clone WITHOUT creating it. Costs nothing, spends no credits, calls no provider. Use this before clone_template so the user knows the price and the resulting aspect/duration first.

intent.description: Short description of what the user wants, max 200 chars. NOT a prompt — the server assembles the final prompt.

product.description: Product to advertise. Omit to keep the template's own product.

avatar.description: Presenter. Omit to keep the template's own.

quality.description: Quality tier. Model ids are server-owned and never accepted here.

overrides.description: Only set these to DELIBERATELY deviate from the template. Leaving them out is what makes it a faithful clone — the template decides aspect and duration.

tools.name: clone_template
tools.description: Clone a template into a real video generation. SPENDS CREDITS. Returns a job id immediately; call get_generation to follow it. The job completes even if nothing polls it.

intent.description: Short description of what the user wants, max 200 chars. NOT a prompt — the server assembles the final prompt.

product.description: Product to advertise. Omit to keep the template's own product.

avatar.description: Presenter. Omit to keep the template's own.

quality.description: Quality tier. Model ids are server-owned and never accepted here.

overrides.description: Only set these to DELIBERATELY deviate from the template. Leaving them out is what makes it a faithful clone — the template decides aspect and duration.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the video models you can render with, and each one's real caps: how many reference images, videos and audios it takes, and the allowed resolution / duration / aspect values. Call this before render_video so you pick settings that exist instead of guessing. Free.

tools.name: preview_render
tools.description: Price a render WITHOUT creating it. Costs nothing, spends no credits, calls no provider. Use this before render_video so the user sees the price first.

model.description: Model id from list_models, e.g. dreamina-seedance-2-ref. Required — there is no default.

prompt.description: Sent to the provider VERBATIM — nothing rewrites it. Provider flags parsed out of prompt text (--seed, --cf, --wm) survive, so they work here.

images.description: Reference image URLs. The FIRST one is the main subject; the rest are scene/product/style. Address them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2…

videos.description: Reference video URLs — the model borrows their motion. @Video1…

audios.description: Reference audio URLs — the model follows their rhythm. @Audio1…

aspect.description: Only values list_models reports for this model.

resolution.description: Only values list_models reports for this model.

duration.description: Seconds. Only values list_models reports for this model.

audio.description: Native audio. Omit to use the model default (usually on).

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Render a video from a raw prompt with any model — the Creative Studio composer as a tool. SPENDS CREDITS. The prompt is sent to the provider VERBATIM, so this is the tool to use when you want exact control rather than a template clone. Returns a job id immediately; call get_generation to follow it.
